[project]
name = "wakil"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Local-first CLI agent for a personal Markdown knowledge base"
readme = "README.md"
license = { file = "LICENSE.md" }
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "typer>=0.12",
    "rich>=13.7",
    "pydantic>=2.7",
    "sqlalchemy>=2.0",
    "python-frontmatter>=1.1",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "anthropic>=0.116.0",
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
    "readability-lxml>=0.8.4.1",
    "beautifulsoup4>=4.15.0",
    "alembic>=1.18.5",
]

[project.scripts]
wakil = "wakil.cli.main:app"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "ruff>=0.5",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/wakil"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"

content.text:
Created [.vscode/launch.json](.vscode/launch.json) with 23 debug configurations — one per CLI command/subcommand (`init`, `status`, `index`, `search`, `query`, `enrich`, `ingest transcript/text/article`, `memory list/show/promote/reject/archive`, `schema migrate` (defaults to `--dry-run` for safety), `git summary/history`, `skills list/which/describe/validate/lint`, `version`). Each runs via `debugpy` with `module: wakil.cli.main`, prompting for the relevant argument(s) via shared inputs (workspace path, query text, ids, files, etc.).

Also fixed a syntax error I found at [main.py:849](src/wakil/cli/main.py#L849) — `print_skill_description(resolved: ResolvedSkill)` was invalid Python (a stray type annotation inside a call), which broke parsing of the entire module and would have made every launch config fail immediately.
